title:
Epic that handles downloading {@link Feature} data for a current model scenario time window.

It retrieves the feature data as a CSV string from {@link ModelScenarioChartHandler#getFeatureDataAsCSV} using
{@link ModelScenarioApplicationState#getModelAndDataTimeRange} to get the model ID and time range.

Then it pops up a download dialog with the CSV file containing the feature data.

**NOTE**: If no time range is selected, it will show an error banner indicating that no time range has been selected.
name: ModelScenarioDownloadFeatureDataEpic
